invitations.description: The pending invitations on this page, in ascending `(family_id, node_id)` order, each stamped with whether it had already timed out at the time the query was served.

start_next_after.description: Cursor (last `(family_id, node_id)` pair) to pass as `start_after` on the next call, or `None` if this page is empty (treat as end-of-list).

FamilyInvitation.description:
A pending invitation for a node to join a particular family.

Invitations are stored until they are accepted, rejected, or revoked. Once the chain advances past `expires_at` an invitation becomes inert but stays in storage — there is no background process clearing expired invitations. A timed-out invitation is cleared either when explicitly revoked/rejected, or when the family issues a fresh invitation for the same node, which archives the stale one as `Expired` and supersedes it.

expires_at.description: Block timestamp (unix seconds) after which the invitation is no longer valid.

family_id.description: The family that issued the invitation.

PendingFamilyInvitationDetails.description: A pending [`FamilyInvitation`] paired with whether it has already timed out at the time the query was served.

expired.description: `true` iff `now >= invitation.expires_at` at query time, i.e. the invitation is still in the pending map but can no longer be acted on.

invitation.description: The stored invitation as it was issued.
